did: Continued KPLAY as a slow-lane choir worker, on four stacked branches with no pull request. Nine endings that close a sentence joined the construction catalogue as a second kind of entry, and conjugation's ad-hoc polite ending retired into one of them. The phrase shelf landed with 14 seed phrases, each held as proposed and heard in the AI voice, and a check that keeps a phrase only when its parts rebuild it and keep every rule. check:phrase checks a proposed phrase before the owner sees it. Shop's machine and runtime take a hunch to home and fill a basket for the session, with the port to home typed ahead of its route. Each slice had a fresh-context review, and every must-fix was applied before its push.

calls.title: Closing endings in the construction catalogue (C1340)
options: a second kind in the one catalogue, typed by kind
a separate list of sentence endings
calls.why: A phrase needs how a sentence closes as well as how clauses join, and one typed family lets a joining ending's refused moods be checked against the closing ending's.
calls.undo: Remove the close entries and restore the polite ending; the ids stay retired.

calls.title: The seed phrase shelf as typed data, proposed until accepted (C1341)
options: a typed module, seeded and marked proposed
hold the seed until the owner accepts each phrase
a JSON deck parsed at load
calls.why: The story asks for a seed shelf and for the owner's acceptance; proposed entries meet both without claiming it.
calls.undo: Remove the phrases module; the ids stay retired.

calls.title: Home decides a hunch's hit or miss and keeps a miss in the same answer (C1342)
options: home decides and keeps a miss in the same answer
the phone applies the threshold and asks home to keep a miss in a second call
hold the machine until home's route exists
calls.why: A second call to keep a miss can fail after the miss was shown, losing the hunch; each hunch is named the same when sent again, so home keeps it once.
calls.undo: Change the port's answer to scores and add a keep effect to the machine.

left: KP4's home half on paulgsc/server: the intent index, a lookup route, a store for unmatched hunches, and hearing a spoken hunch, as #2853 lists.
After it, in some-ui: KP4's contract, its HTTP adapter and the hunch door on What are you hungry for, then KP5's routine part.
KP1's curriculum grades, which wait on a session that can reach kcenter.korean.go.kr.
